slides.title: Propaganda I'm not falling for as a clinic office manager

slides.myth: "The licensing board will remind us before anyone's license lapses."
slides.fact: Maybe. Maybe it goes to an old email. The date is still on you.

slides.myth: "Everyone's CPR cards expire at the same time."
slides.fact: They expire whenever each person took the class. Which is never the same month.
Somewhere is not a renewal date.

slides.myth: "The insurance renews itself, so we're fine."
slides.fact: Renewals still need someone to read them. Check the dates, not the vibes.

slides.label: Propaganda I AM falling for
slides.title: Every license, card and policy date in one place. Checked early.
slides.body: Save this for the next renewal season.
